title: Bringing Solutions, Not Just Problems
meta: B2 · 约 280 词 · 场景：向上汇报问题

sections.heading: 1. The Rule Has a Catch
paragraphs: Many managers like to say, "Don't bring me problems, bring me solutions."
The idea is good: people who arrive with a plan save everyone time.
But taken too far, the rule has a dangerous ==side effect==.
Engineers start hiding problems until they have a fix.
A storage issue that could have been handled in a week __stays quiet__ for a month, until it becomes an ==outage==.
By then, the cheap options are gone.
**Raise problems early, and bring your best thinking, even if it is not a finished solution.**
Your manager doesn't need a perfect answer from you.
They need to know you have __thought it through__ and that you are not just handing them a ==burden== without context.
Half a plan delivered on Monday is worth more than a full plan delivered after the damage.
paragraphs_zh: 很多经理喜欢说：「别光给我带问题来，要带解决方案来。」
出发点是好的：带着方案来的人能给大家省时间。
但如果执行过了头，这条规则会有一个危险的副作用。
工程师会开始把问题捂着，直到想出办法为止。
一个本来一周就能处理掉的存储问题，被闷了一个月，直到变成一次线上故障。
到那时，低成本的选项都已经没了。
问题要早点提，带上你最好的思考，哪怕还不是一个完整的方案。
你的经理不需要你给出完美的答案。
他需要知道你已经认真想过了，而不是没头没尾地把一个包袱甩给他。
周一交上来的半个方案，比损失造成之后才交的完整方案更有价值。

sections.heading: 2. A Simple Four-Part Message
paragraphs: Start with the problem and its ==severity== in one sentence.
"Our storage will be full in about three weeks, and writes will start failing."
Your manager now knows how urgent this is before you say anything else.
Next, offer two or three options with their costs.
"We can clean up old logs, which __buys us__ a month, or add capacity, which costs budget but solves it for a year."
Options show your manager the ==landscape==, not just one path.
Then give your ==recommendation== and the reason behind it.
"I suggest cleaning up now and requesting capacity for next quarter."
**Having a recommendation is what turns you from a messenger into an owner.**
Finally, say what you need from them: approval, budget, or simply ==awareness==.
If you truly have no solution yet, __say so plainly__ and bring the exact question you are stuck on instead.
paragraphs_zh: 先用一句话讲清楚问题和它的严重程度。
「我们的存储大概三周后就会满，到时候写入会开始失败。」
这样你还没往下说，经理就已经知道这事有多急了。
接下来，给出两三个选项，以及各自的代价。
「我们可以清理旧日志，这能多撑一个月；或者扩容，要花预算，但能管一年。」
选项能让经理看到全局，而不只是一条路。
然后给出你的建议，以及背后的理由。
「我建议现在先清理，同时为下个季度申请扩容。」
有了自己的建议，你就从一个传话的人变成了一个负责的人。
最后，说明你需要他做什么：批准、预算，或者只是知会一声。
如果你确实还没有方案，就直说，然后把你卡住的那个具体问题带过来。

gist.q: 「别带问题来，带方案来」这条规则有什么副作用？
gist.a: 工程师会在想出解决办法之前一直藏着问题，小问题拖成事故，便宜的选项也没了。

gist.q: 作者认为经理真正需要的是什么？
gist.a: 不是完美答案，而是早点知道问题，并且看到你认真想过、带着背景和思路来，而不是把包袱直接甩给他。

gist.q: 推荐的四段式汇报是什么？
gist.a: 一句话讲清问题和严重程度；给两三个带成本的选项；给出你的推荐和理由；说明需要经理做什么（批准、预算或只是知情）。

prompts.q: 你发现一个第三方 SDK 下个月停止支持，影响你们的推送功能。用 30 秒按「问题和严重程度、选项、推荐、需要什么」向经理汇报。
prompts.ref: Quick heads-up on a risk. The push notification library we use stops being supported next month, and after that, new phones may not receive our notifications. I see two options: upgrade to the vendor's new version, which takes about a week, or switch to a different provider, which takes a month but cuts cost. I recommend the upgrade now. I just need your approval to pause one small feature this sprint.
prompts.ref_zh: 提前跟你同步一个风险。我们用的推送通知库下个月就停止维护了，之后新手机可能收不到我们的通知。我看有两个选项：升级到厂商的新版本，大概要一周；或者换一家服务商，要一个月，但能降成本。我建议现在就升级。我只需要你批准这个 sprint 先暂停一个小功能。

prompts.q: 你发现了一个性能问题但还没想到解决方案。用 30 秒向经理提出，说明你目前的判断和卡在哪里。
prompts.ref: I want to flag something early, even though I don't have a fix yet. Checkout latency has been creeping up about ten percent a week for the past month. It's not urgent today, but at this rate we'll feel it during the holiday sale. My best guess is the new recommendation call, but I can't confirm it. What I'm stuck on is getting tracing access to that service. Could you help me get it?
prompts.ref_zh: 有件事我想早点提出来，虽然我还没有解决办法。过去一个月，结账延迟每周大约上涨百分之十。今天还不算紧急，但照这个速度，到假期大促的时候就会有明显感觉。我最大的怀疑是新加的推荐接口调用，但还没法确认。我卡在拿不到那个服务的 tracing 权限上。你能帮我申请一下吗？

words.ex: One side effect of the new cache is slightly stale prices.
The outage lasted forty minutes and affected two regions.
I don't want to put the burden of the migration on the new hires.
We classified the bug as high severity because payments were affected.
Before we choose a vendor, let's map out the landscape.
My recommendation is to delay the launch by one week.
No action needed, this is just for awareness.
I don't want to be just the messenger; here's what I suggest.
We need more storage capacity before the holiday peak.
